author: GodsNPC
quote: It's no longer GTA, it's more like The Sims mixed with labor job, and dating simulator, with a little bit of action thrown in. The action itself is terrible. Apparently, you can dodge bullets simply by jumping. And perhaps the most disappointing part is how heavily politicised the game has become. To make matters worse, you can even receive a permanent ban simply for killing npcs for fun in a game where violence has always been one of its core elements. It's hard to recognise what GTA has become.
